summary.content:
Today's selection covers 63 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 46 on Artificial Intelligence and 12 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Hugging Face CEO calls for ‘radical transparency’ after ‘unprecedented’ OpenAI hack
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: ShinyHunters data leaks fuel $2,000 sextortion email scam
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from TechCrunch, NY Times Tech, BBC Technology, BleepingComputer, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 7 articles published in the last 24 hours

top.title: Hugging Face CEO calls for ‘radical transparency’ after ‘unprecedented’ OpenAI hack
